card.name: Reduced-effect wording in interaction text
card.fires_on: Words in drug interaction passages that lead into reduced efficacy or lower active-metabolite levels, such as 'efficacy', 'effect', 'ineffective', 'due to' and the '2' in CYP2C19.

modes.label: Efficacy words
modes.description: The word efficacy or effect right after analgesic or opioid, in a loss-of-effect statement.
modes.example: potentially resulting in decreased opioid<< efficacy>> or a withdrawal syndrome in patients who had

modes.label: Linking words before reduction
modes.description: Small words such as to, can, be or in that precede a statement of reduced response or impaired metabolism.
modes.example: The metabolism of clopidogrel to its active metabolite<< can>> be impaired by genetic variations in CYP

modes.label: Inside CYP names
modes.description: The digit within a CYP enzyme name in metabolism text.
modes.example: metabolized to its active metabolite in part by CYP<<2>>C19. Concomitant use
